name: setup-manaflow-ai-claude-code-send-pop
description: Opt-in. The Claude desktop app's own entrance for a sent message: the prompt is in place at once and pops from its trailing edge, past its size by about 0.25% at 300 ms, and settles by 450 ms. The thread, its room and the thinking row still land in one frame. It follows ui.animationSpeed and Reduce Motion. Remove it and the instant send comes back.
